faqs.question: What are your support hours?
faqs.answer: Support is available Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time.

faqs.question: How can I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Use the Forgot Password link on the sign-in page and follow the email instructions.

faqs.question: How do I contact a human agent?
faqs.answer: Ask to speak with a support agent. Complex or unresolved issues are escalated by email.

faqs.question: Where can I find billing information?
faqs.answer: Open Account Settings and select Billing to view invoices and payment details.

faqs.question: How long do refunds take?
faqs.answer: Approved refunds are normally processed within 5–10 business days, depending on the payment provider.
